traditional: 搞到 A 好唔開心
jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1

english.note: Use this construction when the emphasis is on causing someone great emotional sadness or distress rather than fear.

examples.english: You leaving without a word caused me great dismay.
examples.traditional: 你唔聲唔聲咁走，搞到我好唔開心。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 seng1 m4 seng1 gam3 zau2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1
